name: primitives-effects-highlight
title: Highlight
description: A dark header bar with a brand, five nav links and an avatar; a rounded highlight moves under the link the pointer is on and fades away when it leaves.
use: A row of nav or tab labels needs a clear moving marker for the hovered or active item.
avoid: It is a bare wrapper with no look of its own, so you must supply highlight colours and adapt it to light themes.
a11y: The marker only follows the mouse, never focus, and aria-selected is put on plain buttons without a tab role. (keyboard: no, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A wide, rounded dark bar on black holds a white rounded-square logo with the name Northwind, five small grey nav links and a tiny round avatar at the far right.
behaves: Pointing at a link fades a lighter rounded rectangle in behind it, and moving between links slides the marker across with a spring. It disappears when the pointer leaves.
customise: Each item is a child with a value, and mode, hover or click, transition, class names and a controlled value are props; the bounds measuring is fixed.
weight: light: One absolutely positioned rectangle measured and animated; idle when nothing hovers.
